name: Tesla Powerwall 3 + Gateway 13.5 kWh

image.alt: Tesla Powerwall 3 battery; the separately housed Gateway included in this package is not pictured.

pros: Combines the battery and solar inverter in one wall mounted unit.
Can back up selected home circuits with the included Gateway.
Extra battery units can add storage without replacing the main unit.
cons: One unit supplies a single phase, so three phase appliances need another solution.
Its 130 kg weight needs substantial wall or floor support.

cost.variant: One AU Powerwall 3 1707000, 13.5 kWh, with Gateway and accessories
cost.basis: Manufacturer Australia equipment configuration includes Powerwall 3 and Backup Gateway, including GST, before installation or rebates. Actual equipment total A$11450 divided by 13.5 usable kWh.

warranty.variant: AU Powerwall 3 1707000 and included Backup Gateway 2
warranty.basis: Ten year hardware defect cover for the AU Powerwall 3 and listed related Gateway. Full term requires internet connection and product registration; disconnected or unregistered products have at least four years. Performance and usage limits are separate.

capacity.basis: Published usable storage for this exact configuration. Actual delivered AC energy also depends on the inverter and operating conditions.

technicalSpecs.label: Selected equipment
technicalSpecs.value: One Powerwall 3 1707000, configured at 10 kW, plus Backup Gateway 2 and accessories. No expansion unit.

technicalSpecs.label: Usable storage
technicalSpecs.value: 13.5 kWh AC at the datasheet test conditions.

technicalSpecs.label: Continuous output
technicalSpecs.value: 10 kW selected AU configuration; actual permitted output depends on network approval and settings. Single phase, 230 V.

technicalSpecs.label: Charging power
technicalSpecs.value: Up to 5 kW with one Powerwall 3 and no expansion unit.

technicalSpecs.label: Solar connection
technicalSpecs.value: Integrated solar inverter supports up to 20 kW of panels across three independently tracked roof groups.

technicalSpecs.label: Blackout coverage
technicalSpecs.value: Included Gateway detects outages and disconnects the grid. Backup is limited by connected circuits, load and stored energy.

technicalSpecs.label: Size and weight
technicalSpecs.value: 1,105 mm high, 609 mm wide, 193 mm deep; 130 kg. Wall or floor mounted.

technicalSpecs.label: Parts warranty conditions
technicalSpecs.value: 10 years when connected and registered; at least four years otherwise. Gateway is also covered by the listed related-product term.

technicalSpecs.label: Capacity promise
technicalSpecs.value: 70% after 10 years. Unlimited cycles for listed self-consumption, time-based control and backup uses; other uses have a 37.8 MWh limit.

technicalSpecs.label: Efficiency scope
technicalSpecs.value: The published 89% solar-to-battery-to-home figure is not an AC-to-AC round trip measurement, so the efficiency bar is unavailable.
